cards.title: Google Search that uses your own Drive and Wallet
cards.what: Lets you opt in to connect Google Wallet, Drive and the Gemini app so AI Mode answers in Search can use your personal information.
cards.try_for: Opt in, then ask AI Mode to summarise your visit notes for a bar account before your next call.
cards.why: The announcement does not say who can use it or where, so it is not clear it is available to staff yet.
cards.catch: Connecting personal accounts means Search answers draw on your files, and the text gives no detail on how this is limited.
cards.data_caution: Do not connect accounts or Drive folders holding confidential pricing, contracts or customer data without IT or legal approval.
cards.original_title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours

cards.title: Gemini app now runs on lower-memory Android phones
cards.what: The Gemini app now works on older or lower-memory Android phones, including Gemini Live and custom image creation.
cards.try_for: Create a rough image concept for a social post idea on your Android phone using the Gemini app's custom image feature.
cards.why: The text says the app is available today on these phones, and image concepts are a task marketing staff already do.
cards.catch: The announcement does not say which phone models qualify or whether any features cost extra, so check your device first.
cards.data_caution: Do not enter unreleased product names, recipes, pricing, or consumer research data into the app.
cards.original_title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
